text.The Oracle:
How to Play ==
When you play The Oracle you put a Outpost in play with a defense of 5. And you may scrap a card in your hand. When the ally ability triggers you gain 3 Combat.
 Strategy ==
The Oracle is a pretty decent Outpost for only 4 trade. With a defense of 5 it may stay up for a round or 2 in early play. Scrap early in the game is great. Less great if it is from your hand though, but still really good. Adding 3 Combat when the ally ability triggers is also decent.
